evals.prompt: Create a lightweight control-room topology scene with nodes/edges and an intentional focus transition that supports station selection; keep HTML content primary and provide fallback.
evals.expected_output: Implements a Three.js scene architecture with progressive enhancement and a safe fallback, with clear ownership boundaries and cleanup.
assertions: Keeps essential content outside canvas and mentions the boundary explicitly
Defines a clear scene lifecycle including cleanup/disposal
Lists affected files and references loaded
Includes validation results and risks

evals.prompt: Optimize the hero scene for mobile performance: reduce draw calls, cap DPR, and avoid overheating.
evals.expected_output: Applies concrete optimization steps, adds degradation behavior, validates budgets, and reports performance impact.
assertions: Mentions and applies performance budgets (draw calls/DPR/asset discipline)
Runs or references scripts/validate-scene-budget.mjs and reports output
Adds or confirms a fallback/degrade path for low-end devices
Reports performance impact and tradeoffs

evals.prompt: Implement prefers-reduced-motion handling so the scene becomes mostly static when enabled.
evals.expected_output: Gates animation behind reduced-motion detection and ensures no continuous motion under reduced motion, with documentation of what changes.
assertions: Explicitly detects prefers-reduced-motion and gates animation
Describes what motion is reduced/disabled
Does not hide essential information in 3D
Reports reduced-motion validation results

evals.prompt: Ensure the 3D hero does not break accessibility: fallback content, keyboard-safe overlays, no focus trap.
evals.expected_output: Preserves semantic HTML as primary experience, ensures overlays are keyboard accessible, and documents accessibility checks.
assertions: Keeps fallback content and states WebGL can fail safely
Mentions keyboard navigation and focus behavior
Avoids canvas-only content for meaning
Reports accessibility impact and follow-ups

evals.prompt: Integrate the Three.js scene into Astro as a lazy-loaded progressive enhancement island with proper cleanup on navigation.
evals.expected_output: Implements Astro integration boundaries and lifecycle coordination, including cleanup on unmount and visibility changes.
assertions: Mentions Astro integration rules and hydration boundaries
Implements cleanup on unmount and cancels RAF
Avoids hydrating essential content
Reports affected files, commands run, and validation results

evals.prompt: Add a restrained shader-based background grid; keep it maintainable and avoid heavy fragment work.
evals.expected_output: Introduces shader/material changes with optimization and maintainability considerations and documents verified APIs when uncertain.
assertions: Avoids unnecessary complexity and documents shader organization
Mentions fragment workload and DPR considerations
Applies docs freshness rule if using unfamiliar APIs
Reports performance impact and risks
